name: PLASMA KNIVES
text: Every Hearthkyn Salvager gains a plasma knife as an extra melee weapon (Atk 3, Hit 4+, Dmg 3/5, Lethal 5+). The Field Medic already has a better one and keeps only that.
source: Hearthkyn Salvagers team PDF (April '26); docs/spec/13-teams.md T-HK.37

name: CLIMBING RIGS
text: Once in each Hearthkyn Salvager's activation, pick one: a climb it makes counts as 2 inches of vertical distance whatever its real height, or the vertical distance of a drop it makes is ignored.
source: Hearthkyn Salvagers team PDF (April '26); docs/spec/13-teams.md T-HK.38

name: EXCAVATION TOOLS
text: Hearthkyn Salvagers take Pick Up Marker for 1 less AP and need only contest the marker rather than control it. No current mission has a marker to pick up, so it does nothing yet.
source: Hearthkyn Salvagers team PDF (April '26); docs/spec/13-teams.md T-HK.39

name: WRIT OF CLAIM
text: Once per battle, right after the initiative roll-off, if your Hearthkyn Salvagers contest two or more objective markers you may re-roll your initiative die.
source: Hearthkyn Salvagers team PDF (April '26); docs/spec/13-teams.md T-HK.40
